command: gate_tmp=$(mktemp -d); python3 skills/claim-evidence/scripts/claim_evidence.py --root "$gate_tmp" init && python3 skills/claim-evidence/scripts/claim_evidence.py --root "$gate_tmp" rebuild && python3 skills/claim-evidence/scripts/claim_evidence.py --root "$gate_tmp" verify; code=$?; unlink "$gate_tmp/generated/projection.json"; unlink "$gate_tmp/canonical/store.json"; unlink "$gate_tmp/canonical/store.lock"; rmdir "$gate_tmp/generated" "$gate_tmp/canonical" "$gate_tmp"; exit $code

actual=$(sha256sum planning/production-claim-evidence-interface/slice-01-accepted-plan.md skills/claim-evidence/SKILL.md skills/claim-evidence/agents/openai.yaml skills/claim-evidence/references/claim-evidence-contract.md skills/claim-evidence/schemas/authority-manifest-v1.schema.json skills/claim-evidence/schemas/claim-evidence-core-v1.schema.json skills/claim-evidence/schemas/operation-v1.schema.json skills/claim-evidence/schemas/proposal-research-v1.schema.json skills/claim-evidence/schemas/revision-bound-review-finding-v1.schema.json skills/claim-evidence/scripts/claim_evidence.py skills/claim-evidence/tests/fixtures/representative-domain-records.json skills/claim-evidence/tests/test_claim_evidence.py | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1); test "$actual" = 0a79fdf7a8ff1e665c4c5c032aa28f88905aec9083b668b7d5472263e219ec5b && test -z "$(git ls-files -- skills/claim-evidence)" && test -z "$(git ls-files -- planning/production-claim-evidence-interface/slice-01-accepted-plan.md)"

status=0; for file in planning/production-claim-evidence-interface/slice-01-accepted-plan.md skills/claim-evidence/SKILL.md skills/claim-evidence/agents/openai.yaml skills/claim-evidence/references/claim-evidence-contract.md skills/claim-evidence/schemas/authority-manifest-v1.schema.json skills/claim-evidence/schemas/claim-evidence-core-v1.schema.json skills/claim-evidence/schemas/operation-v1.schema.json skills/claim-evidence/schemas/proposal-research-v1.schema.json skills/claim-evidence/schemas/revision-bound-review-finding-v1.schema.json skills/claim-evidence/scripts/claim_evidence.py skills/claim-evidence/tests/fixtures/representative-domain-records.json skills/claim-evidence/tests/test_claim_evidence.py; do git diff --no-index --check /dev/null "$file"; code=$?; if [ "$code" -gt 1 ]; then status=$code; fi; done; exit "$status"

test "$(sha256sum planning/production-claim-evidence-interface/review-provider-amendment-01.md | cut -d' ' -f1)" = 39f610d57b2f19fd016277b28687fc9d17332a3d65e1c05760b73067dec8656f && test ! -e skills/claim-evidence/scripts/__pycache__ && test ! -e skills/claim-evidence/tests/__pycache__
